column1: # The models that .github/scripts/formal.py runs (AUD-5, #389): <name> <files> <what it is> [<slices>], separated by tabs.

# with the pinned ProVerif (.github/scripts/formal.py run). The queries of the files are numbered by their
# (* @query id *) comments, and expected.tsv says what each must give in each variant. A line that starts
# slices: ProVerif keeps its state for every query of a run, so a variant with many queries, or a heavy one, runs
# as that many ProVerif runs, each with consecutive queries of its own and a job of its own in formal.yml. 1 when
# The session variants have the same ProVerif text but for the process at the end of the last file: the
# compromise variants leak the keys of the nodes in phase 0 and in phase 1, the honest ones leak nothing.
